meta.title: SYNTHETIC demonstration — not real occurrence data
meta.scope: Synthetic numbers made up to show how the module works. They are not aviation occurrence data and do not follow Heinrich’s or any other ratio. See docs/ACCIDENT-PYRAMID.md.

dataset.name: Synthetic dataset A
dataset.description: Invented counts of events at a fictitious operator group, ordered from most to least severe.
dataset.inclusion: Synthetic: all events reported through the fictitious reporting system.
dataset.reportingLimitations: Synthetic data; reporting culture and completeness are not modelled.

exposure.definition: Synthetic: total flight hours of the fictitious operator group in the period

categories.label: Fatal or serious-injury accident
categories.definition: Synthetic definition: an event with a fatality or serious injury.

categories.label: Accident with minor injury or damage
categories.definition: Synthetic definition: minor injury or damage, no serious injury.

categories.label: Incident without injury or damage
categories.definition: Synthetic definition: an event reported as an incident.

categories.label: Hazard or near-miss report
categories.definition: Synthetic definition: a reported hazard or near miss.
